transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
To be honest, I've just been feeling severely depressed and down for about a year and ten months now. It feels like this heavy cloud is constantly over me, and I just can't seem to shake it.
Have you had periods lasting at least two months where you felt significantly better, or have your symptoms been present almost every day without much relief during this time?
I'm not quite sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about whether I've had any breaks like that, as it just feels like it's been one long, continuous struggle.
Can you recall if there was ever a time in the past two years when you felt significantly better for several weeks or more, where your mood lifted and daily functioning improved?

No, I really can't recall any period like that over the last year and ten months. It has felt completely continuous, without any times where my mood lifted or I felt significantly better. It has just been a constant, unchanging struggle the entire time.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "daily functioning",
  "question": "How has this ongoing low mood affected your ability to carry out daily activities, work, or relationships?"

I have completely lost the motivation to do my work or even basic daily tasks, so everything just piles up. I've also been pulling away from my friends and family, and I no longer have any interest in the hobbies I used to love.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "chronicity and onset",
  "question": "Did your low mood start before you turned 21, or can you remember when it first began?"
No, it didn't start before I turned 21. It actually began much more recently, about a year and ten months ago, and has just been continuous since then.
In addition to your low mood, have you experienced periods of significantly elevated mood, increased energy, or decreased need for sleep lasting several days or more?

No, I've never experienced anything like that. I have mostly just felt really low and completely lacking in motivation this entire time. I definitely haven't had any periods of high energy or a decreased need for sleep.
Have you had trouble with sleep, appetite changes, or feelings of worthlessness nearly every day during this time?

Sleep hasn't really been my main issue, but my appetite has completely dropped and I've lost a lot of weight. On top of that, I am constantly overwhelmed by intense feelings of worthlessness, feeling like I'm completely useless every single day.
To confirm, have your symptoms of low mood, poor appetite, and feelings of worthlessness been present for most of the day, more days than not, for at least two years?
Yes, those feelings have been present almost constantly every single day, but it hasn't quite been two full years yet. It has actually been about one year and ten months since this all started.

Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt extremely low, lost interest in nearly all activities, and experienced additional symptoms such as fatigue, difficulty concentrating, or thoughts of death?

Yes, I have felt extremely low and completely lost interest or pleasure in almost all activities for the entire year and ten months. I also suffer from a severe lack of motivation, but I definitely do not have any thoughts of death. As for fatigue or concentration issues, I'm not really sure about those.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "cognitive symptoms",
  "question": "Have you had ongoing problems with fatigue or trouble concentrating nearly every day during this time?"
I'm not really sure about that. I haven't really noticed having ongoing problems with fatigue or trouble concentrating during this time.
